full_judgment: 20. The burden of proof under section 101 of the Evidence Act lies with the party who substantially asserts the affirmative of the issue and not with the party that denies it. It is reasonable and just that the suitor who relies upon the existence of the fact should be called upon to prove his own case. In the instant case, the onus of proof lies with the petitioners as they assert that the impugned order dated 5-5-2004 committed an error of law. So the petitioners, in order to succeed must prove that the impugned order committed error in the decision. But the petitioners totally fail to discharge the burden which lies with them.
